# Artifact Keeper 1.11.6

A small maintenance release on the 1.11 line: 2 changelog entries from 2 pull requests since 1.11.5, both backported from `main` in #4912. The headline is **the PyPI age gate no longer blocks old releases whose filename spells the version differently from the Warehouse release** (#4907, in #4908), which broke `pip install torch==2.14.1` on Linux through a proxied PyPI repository with the age gate enabled. Next to it, the `ctutils` dependency moves to 0.4.5 for RUSTSEC-2026-0385 (#4910). **No schema migrations** (the line stays at migration 289), no new settings, and no security advisories ship with this release. Upgrading is a normal image bump.

## What changed

- **The PyPI age gate matches PEP 440-equal version spellings when it looks up a publish time** (#4907, in #4908). The gate looked up a distribution's publish time by the exact version string in its filename, but Warehouse keys `releases` by the release's own spelling. So `cuda_toolkit-13.0.3.0-py2.py3-none-any.whl`, which sits under release `13.0.3` and was uploaded months earlier, found no publish time and was withheld with a `451` indefinitely. Because torch pins `cuda-toolkit==13.0.3`, `pip install torch==2.14.1` failed on Linux. The lookup now tries the exact spelling first and falls back to PEP 440 equality, on the download path and in both the HTML and JSON simple-index listing filters. When more than one release spelling matches, the youngest publish time wins, so the fallback is never more lenient than an exact match. A version that is not PEP 440-equal to any release (for example `13.0.3.1` or `13.0.3.post0`) still has no publish time and stays gated.
- **`ctutils` bumped 0.4.0 to 0.4.5 for RUSTSEC-2026-0385** (#4910). `ctutils` 0.4.0 generated masks and compared `u128` values in non-constant time. It reaches the backend through `crypto-bigint` under the `bergshamra` XML signature crates. Lockfile-only, with no behaviour change.

## Upgrade notes

None beyond the normal image bump. There is no migration, no configuration change and no change to any API response other than the PyPI downloads and simple-index entries that were wrongly withheld before.

The full entries are in the `## [1.11.6]` section of [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/artifact-keeper/artifact-keeper/blob/v1.11.6/CHANGELOG.md).
